text:
maya: Opening a small PR to refresh the Quickstart hello-world steps. Plan: tighten auth wording, add a one-line curl test, include a tiny Vercel serverless ephemeral-token example, and modernize SDK snippets to client v8. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 (WIP).
ryan: split into commits: (1) docs/auth, (2) SDK snippet swap, (3) minor link fixes. makes reviews much easier.
nora: please add a curl example under 'Test locally' so folks can rule out network vs SDK issues. most newcomers try curl first.
maya: added curl example (inline): curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hello from curl"}'
selma: also include a short Docker note: EXPOSE 3000 in Dockerfile and run with docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY -p 3000:3000 my-hello.
ryan: i'll convert fetch examples to the Client pattern in a separate commit. please add a line recommending pinning model versions to avoid silent regressions (example: model: "redwood/gpt-small:2025-01-01").
nora: tiny nit: keep env var consistently named REDWOOD_API_KEY in all samples.
maya: affirmed, keeping REDWOOD_API_KEY. added a one-line Vercel serverless handler sample and a caution to cache ephemeral tokens only per invocation.
maya: local smoke test steps added: npm ci && npm run start, then run the curl above. note about clearing KV cache if outputs look stale.
deploy-bot: deploy-preview queued for PR 5123  preview link ETA ~7m.
deploy-bot: preview for PR 5123 finished (status: success)  https://deploy-preview-5123--docs.redwood.ai
ryan: will review SDK commit later today. if green, merge and open follow-up issue to migrate remaining examples.
maya: created follow-up issue docs#238 to migrate remaining examples to client v8 next sprint and assigned ryan. merging after CI. thanks all :tada: 
ryan: thanks, will pick up issue docs#238. closing thread.
